name: omi_messaging_worker_failures
description: Content-free messaging log count: worker failures by reason.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="backend" AND textPayload:"Messaging job failed"

labels.description: Bounded operational failure reason; never customer identifiers.

name: omi_messaging_webhook_5xx
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="backend" AND httpRequest.requestUrl:"/v1/messaging/webhooks/" AND httpRequest.status>=500

name: omi_messaging_outbound_failures
description: Content-free messaging log count: outbound delivery failures.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="backend" AND (textPayload:"Messaging failure reply failed" OR textPayload:"reason=delivery_uncertain" OR (textPayload:"Messaging job failed" AND textPayload:"error_type=ProviderError"))

name: omi_messaging_maintenance_failures
description: Content-free messaging log count: maintenance failure by reason.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="messaging-maintenance-job" AND textPayload:"Messaging maintenance outcome=failed"

labels.description: Bounded operational failure reason; never customer identifiers.

name: omi_messaging_stale_heads
description: Content-free messaging log count: stale queue head.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="backend" AND textPayload:"Messaging queue" AND (textPayload:"reason=stale_pending" OR textPayload:"reason=stale_running")

name: omi_messaging_recovery_unavailable
description: Content-free messaging log count: Pending recovery failing.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="backend" AND textPayload:"Messaging recovery paused"
